column3: “Cities to fortification” is rendered “cities for defense.”
NASB supplies “he put”; “it belonged to him” is rendered “he held.”
“Took their stand at him” is rendered “stood with him,” and “territory” as “districts.”
“For himself” is rendered “of his own,” and “goats” as “satyrs.”
The Hebrew does not say how Abihail is related; NASB adds “and of,” making her a parent. The meaning is uncertain.
“Appointed to the chief” is rendered “appointed … as head”; NASB supplies “he intended.”
NASB supplies “for them” with “many wives”; the Hebrew does not say for whom, and the meaning is uncertain.
